description: Admin-only: update the shared public query mapping behind a system alert rule for all customer copies. Write action; requires confirmation.

applyGlobally.description: Must be true. Updates the shared public query mapping used by all system rule copies.

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

expectedCurrentSqlHash.description: Optional SHA-256 hash of the current SQL to prevent stale overwrites.

id.description: Alert rule id. Must be a system rule.

reactivatePausedCopies.description: Whether to reactivate paused noisy copies after the query is tuned.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.

reviewNote.description: Optional review note. Defaults to reason.

reviewNotificationId.description: Optional notification id tied to this review/tuning action.

sqlQuery.description: Full replacement SQL query. System SQL must keep __USER_APP_KEYS__ for tenant scoping.

name: securenow_alert_rule_query_update
title: Update System Alert Rule Query
